messages:
alice.k: Quick sync: I spun up an experimental "ensemble" speculative pipeline combining a small fp16 greedy model (tied to fastpath) + a quantized 7B sampler as fallback. Wanted to dump initial notes here before I forget.
ben_p: Nice. High level perf numbers?
alice.k: Baseline (70B fp16, single-model) p50 latency ~220ms on our dedicated instances for seq=512. Ensemble fastpath (8B fp16) + late-fallback to quant-70b gives p50 ~95ms (fastpath) and p95 ~240ms when fallback hits. Overall tail slightly worse but median much better.
carol_s: How often does fallback trigger?
alice.k: In our 5k prompt eval set fallback rate ~12%. Fallback prob correlates with low-confidence tokens (topp mass < 0.6) and with prompts containing multi-step reasoning.
dmitri: What about quality? Any regression on the eval suites?
alice.k: Ran our standard onboard battery: truthbench (factual QA), codegen-smoke, and human-scored summarization subset. Summary: automated metrics (exact match / BLEU variants) drop by ~0.8-1.5 points on truthbench for fastpath-only answers. But fallback recovers ~70% of those regressions. Net end-to-end quality (weighted by observed fallback rate) is -0.3 points vs baseline.
ellie-r: That's not bad for a ~2x median speedup. What's the cost impact?
alice.k: Cost per token drops ~35% due to cheaper fastpath tokens, but extra fallback tokens inflate costs for the 12% bucket — net cost ~ -22% overall.
ben_p: Implementation details? How are you routing and scoring confidence?
alice.k: Fastpath runs on a tiny 8B fp16 model with KV caching. We compute a per-step confidence score: softmax concentration metric (max prob / sum top-k probs) and also delta-logprob from local ngram model for heuristics. If score < threshold or decoding entropy spikes we append a short signature and trigger speculative fallback with the quantized 70B model using last-K prefix continuity.
mitri: Are you doing any prefix rerolling or merging outputs?
alice.k: Yes: when fallback returns a different top token we prefer fallback output for that position and rescore subsequent tokens by re-running fastpath with forced prefix to ensure KV sync. We log both outputs and compute a "merge cost" metric (token differences + surprisal delta).
carol_s: How reproducible is this across quantization schemes? We have QA regressions with int4 in past tests.
alice.k: We profiled int4 vs int8 qat/awq on the 70B fallback. AWQ-int4 had slightly higher perplexity; fallback quality slightly worse by ~0.6 points vs AWQ-int8. For production-looking configs I'm leaning AWQ-int8 + more conservative fallback threshold.
ellie-r: Any weird failure modes?
alice.k: Two we flagged: 1) fallback thrashing on chat sessions with short turns — calls fallback multiple times causing oscillation and longer total latency. 2) hallucination divergence where fastpath shadows incorrect token with high prob so heuristic doesn't trigger fallback; fallback could have avoided error but we never call it.
ben_p: For (2) can we use a cheap verifier model or an internal classifier to flag hallucination risk?
alice.k: We tried a 300M verifier on the fly but it added latency and caused false positives. But running verifier asynchronously and using its score to trigger background re-rerank seems promising.
ops-bot: canary:deployed alice-spec-ensemble v0.1 -> eng-ml at 2026-03-21T15:02:10Z :rocket:
carol_s: Great. Next steps?
alice.k: Action items: (1) run a larger 50k prompt sweep on mixed domains to firm up fallback threshold (assigned ben_p), (2) test AWQ-int8 + slightly higher reg threshold (assigned carol_s), (3) instrument session-level debounce for fallback to avoid thrashing (assigned dmitri). I'll also prepare a short eval doc with per-prompt logging formats.
ben_p: I'll kick off the sweep now and share early dashboards.
dmitri: Will experiment with session debounce heuristics (windowed fallback cool-down).
carol_s: I'll do AWQ-int8 runs and holdout comparisons vs fp16 baseline.
ellie-r: Please tag me on the eval doc when ready, want to run cost projections for Dedicated plans.
alice.k: Thanks all — logging full run artifacts to s3://redwood-experiments/ensemble-spec/3599990000/ and will update this thread with the eval doc link once it exists.
